master.description: Besides providing a new way to get on the water, paddleboarding develops core muscles and balance it's the perfect training activity for surfers, skiers and paddlers
master.features: Incredibly stable 33 in. width offers stability that inspires confidence in beginning paddlers. EPS, epoxy and fiberglass construction reduces weight and creates high responsiveness
master.name: Even Keel Paddleboard
master.reviews: By djslalom from Lee Vining, CA The board was nice to get started, but now that I've gotten my stroke down, a left turn bias has become dramatically apparent. A fin box misalignment might be causing this. Finally, in less than a year, a bubble has appeared under the skin on the hull side (despite careful storage). Requests for a remedy from the manufacturer was deferred to the salesman, and both have become unresponsive. I would absolutely avoid this company and am spreading the word.
